lines.text: Hi, is this Marcus? This is Boris, the AI assistant at Alamo Injury Law, returning your call. This call is recorded.
Oh, yeah. Thanks for calling back. I got T-boned on 410 at Blanco about two weeks ago. The other guy ran a red light.
I broke my left wrist. Surgery's next week. And I've had headaches ever since.
Thank you. Was there a police report?
Yes. And a witness stopped and gave the officer her number.
That helps. Do you know the other driver's insurance?
Got it. Can you come in today at 2:30 to meet Grant Whitaker, one of our attorneys?
You're booked. I'm texting you the address and a summary.
